source.title: Combined PD-1 and HER2 blockade for HER2-positive gastric cancer
source.source_type: primary randomized double-blind placebo-controlled phase III trial report, protocol-specified first interim analysis

source_integrity_notes: The manuscript is a protocol-specified first interim analysis centered on objective response. PFS and OS were not yet reported in this source.
The protocol supplement contains sponsor redactions. Redacted content was not reconstructed or inferred.
The source reports a US FDA approval that occurred around the publication period. Current regulatory status was not externally verified because @VERIFY was not activated.
The SEA protocol file is named v4-compact but its internal heading says Integrated Compact v3. Project precedence makes the v4-named file authoritative.
All language-model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer step is represented.
